system.name: Canvas
system.one_liner: isolates and adaptively swaps remote memory for multiple co-located applications

content.subject: how a page cycles between hot, cold, and swapped-out states, and when it keeps or releases its swap-entry reservation

elements.role: Init: newly allocated page, before it is classified hot or cold
Hot Page: accessed frequently; carries no reserved swap-entry to manage
Cold Page without a reserved swap-entry; swapping it out uses the normal allocation path
Swapped-out Page: the page's data currently lives in remote memory
Cold Page that still remembers its swap-entry ID from a previous swap-out

transitions.guard: brand new page, never swapped out

is the page currently being accessed frequently?

content.key_idea: Splitting the cold-page state in two, with and without a remembered swap-entry, lets Canvas make repeated swap-outs lock-free instead of reallocating an entry every time.
content.reading_order: starts at state 1 (Init), branches to 3 (Hot) or 2 (Cold), then follows 2 to 4 (Swapped-out), 4 to 5 (Cold with entry), and 5 back to either 4 (lock-free swap-out) or 3 (becomes hot)

summary: This figure is the finite state machine Canvas uses to manage a page's swap-entry reservation under remote-memory pressure. A newly allocated page (state 1) can become a Hot Page (state 3) or a Cold Page (state 2); a hot page unaccessed for a while also cools into state 2. A cold page in state 2 has no reserved swap entry, so swapping it out goes through normal allocation into the Swapped-out Page state (state 4). When later swapped back in, the page keeps its swap-entry ID, entering a second cold state, state 5, whose next swap-out skips allocation and is lock-free, returning to state 4. If a state-5 page becomes hot again, Canvas removes its swap-entry ID and frees the reservation, moving to state 3. Distinguishing state 2 from state 5 lets Canvas reuse swap entries instead of reallocating on every swap-out.
summary_zh: 该图是Canvas页面状态机：新页(1)变热(3)或变冷(2)，热页久未访问转为2；2态无entry，换出后进入已换出态(4)；换入后记住entry进入5态，再换出可无锁复用回到4；5态变热则释放entry回到3，复用条目而非每次重分配。
notes: Diagonal arrows 1->3 and 1->2, and the vertical 2<->3 arrow, carry no guard text in the figure and are not directly described in the given paragraph (which focuses on states 2, 4, and 5); they are included since they are visibly drawn, with 'what' noting the lack of an explicit label rather than inventing one. Palette hex values are grouped by visual role from the source-SVG histogram; each state box has two close shades (main face + bevelled side).
